annotations.title: Route a situation to the right guides and stacks

description: Describe the user's situation or goal in their own words (e.g. "I'm a journalist protecting sources", "I just bought a Pixel and want GrapheneOS", "which password manager", "I want to use AI more privately") and get the best-matching Default Privacy situations, each with the guides and stacks to read. The standard starting set is always included. Open a result with dp_get_guide or dp_get_stack. For a keyword lookup use dp_search instead.

situation.description: The situation or goal, in the user's own words.
